topic: What if everyone disappeared except you?

script.text: You wake up at 7:12, and something is wrong. It's quiet. Too quiet. No traffic. No birds. No Mum shouting that you're going to be late.
Her coffee is on the kitchen table, still warm. Her car keys are next to it. Her phone's alarm is going off, and nobody is turning it off.
Outside, a bus is stopped in the middle of the road, doors open, engine running. Nobody on it. A dog trots down the empty street, dragging its lead. Nobody holding it.
You shout. Your voice bounces off a hundred windows, and nobody answers.
You check every house on the street. Every shop. Every car. Everything is exactly where it was last night. Every light. Every open laptop. Every half-eaten sandwich. Except the people.
Everyone on Earth is gone. Everyone, except you. What if everyone disappeared, except you?

title: WHAT IF EVERYONE
DISAPPEARED EXCEPT YOU?
